name: Mita Suthar
bio: Dr Mita Suthar is an Associate Professor in Economics and Public Policy area. A gold medalist at master's level, she acquired her PhD in 2006, with a specialization in Macroeconometrics. Her research involved econometric modelling of Indian macroeconomic variables and an analysis of the monetary and credit policy of the Reserve Bank of India. Her later research involves works on macroeconomic volatility, foreign exchange rate determination, inflation targeting, productivity and growth issues in the industrial sector and developmental issues related to cultural economics. Dr Suthar has presented her research at various international and national conferences. Some of these include presentations at Econometric Society Annual Meetings, Eurasia Business and Economics Society, Nepal Rastra Bank, University of Economics in Bratislava and the Indian Econometric Society. She has been an Academic Visitor to University of Cambridge, UK and a Visiting Fellow to Wolfson College, University of Cambridge, UK. Her publications include a book titled Monetary Policy in Macroeconomic Management: An Indian Perspective and research articles in various journals and edited volumes.
